findings.title: K04/K05/K07 failures are stale-debris artifacts, not production bugs

evidence.screenshot: K01-kds-grid-visible.png shows 31 BORNE orders consuming all 8 visible FIFO slots, '+23 en attente' overflow badge top-right
evidence.root_cause: DB has 54 prior test orders (status 4/7/8) on business_date=today. Seeded test orders land at FIFO tail → never visible in top 8 → DOM assertions on .kds-card__delivery / .kds-card__allergen-pill / specific CTA click fail because the target card is off-screen.

findings.reproduction: Run spec → K04 expects .kds-card__delivery>=1 (DELIVERY phone gate) but no DELIVERY card visible in top 8. K05 expects .kds-card__allergen-pill>=1 but only K01-K04 leftover POS cards visible. K07 clicks .kds-card__cta first instance which targets a different older order (status 4) not the K07-seeded status 7.
findings.impact: Spec-only — system is healthy. Recommend pre-test purge of orders.business_date=today before each test in beforeAll() (or scope to short-lived branch_id=99 test branch).
